item.title: Quantum Australia Reports $83.1M Economic Impact and Growth of 15 Quantum Companies
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – New independent modelling has been released that shows Quantum Australia‘s national programs have created $83.1 million in economic value while supporting more than six times the public investment in economy-wide activity.
